verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents general triage workflows (alerts/tickets for findings) and AI-based noise reduction (~20% fewer false positives via Semgrep Assistant), which speaks to the 'gate on noise' theme, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of severity or confidence-level filtering/gating flags (e.g., --severity, confidence thresholds) that a developer would use to configure CI gating. missing for 10: documented --severity/--confidence CLI flags or policy config, explicit examples of gating CI builds by severity/confidence tiers, independent confirmation that such filtering reduces noise in practice.
